Please help me identify the top 3 bowlers who, in the overs where the maximum runs were conceded in each match, gave up the highest number of runs in a single over across all matches. For each of these bowlers, provide the match in which they conceded these maximum runs. Only consider overs that had the most runs conceded within their respective matches, and among these, determine which bowlers conceded the most runs in a single over overall.

content.text:
This is a complex request that requires multiple steps to solve. Here's my plan:

1.  First, I will calculate the total runs conceded in each over of every match. This includes runs scored by the batsman and any extra runs.
2.  Next, for each match, I will identify the over(s) where the maximum number of runs were conceded.
3.  Then, I will determine the bowler who bowled each of these "maximum-run" overs.
4.  Finally, I will rank these bowlers based on the number of runs they conceded in that single over, and select the top 3. I will also retrieve the match ID for each of these performances. This will give us the top 3 bowlers who conceded the most runs in a single over that was also the most expensive over of that particular match.

args.sql:
WITH runs_per_over AS (
    SELECT
        match_id,
        over_id,
        innings_no,
        SUM(runs) AS runs_in_over
    FROM (
        SELECT
            match_id,
            over_id,
            innings_no,
            runs_scored AS runs
        FROM ipl.main.batsman_scored
        UNION ALL
        SELECT
            match_id,
            over_id,
            innings_no,
            extra_runs AS runs
        FROM ipl.main.extra_runs
    )
    GROUP BY
        match_id,
        over_id,
        innings_no
),
max_runs_per_match_over AS (
    SELECT
        rpo.match_id,
        rpo.over_id,
        rpo.innings_no,
        rpo.runs_in_over
    FROM runs_per_over rpo
    JOIN (
        SELECT
            match_id,
            MAX(runs_in_over) AS max_runs
        FROM runs_per_over
        GROUP BY
            match_id
    ) mrpm
        ON rpo.match_id = mrpm.match_id AND rpo.runs_in_over = mrpm.max_runs
),
bowler_runs AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT
        mrpmo.match_id,
        mrpmo.runs_in_over,
        b.bowler AS bowler_id
    FROM max_runs_per_match_over mrpmo
    JOIN ipl.main.ball_by_ball b
        ON mrpmo.match_id = b.match_id
        AND mrpmo.over_id = b.over_id
        AND mrpmo.innings_no = b.innings_no
),
ranked_bowlers AS (
    SELECT
        p.player_name,
        br.runs_in_over,
        br.match_id,
        RANK() OVER (ORDER BY br.runs_in_over DESC) as rank_num
    FROM bowler_runs br
    JOIN ipl.main.player p
        ON br.bowler_id = p.player_id
)
SELECT
    player_name,
    runs_in_over,
    match_id
FROM ranked_bowlers
WHERE rank_num <= 3
ORDER BY
    runs_in_over DESC
